Build the table and room around this viewpoint, with shared vanishing geometry. The laptop faces the accessible far working edge and chair, not the camera; keep its full base supported with clear space around it.

The oak worktable occupies the lower frame, with visible grain, a subtle contact shadow and sufficient surface beneath every weight-bearing part. A plain unlabelled warm-gray document storage box sits in the near-left plane on the tabletop beside the laptop, partly cropped by the left border, within reach but outside the keyboard approach. A charcoal upholstered office chair occupies the mid-left plane across the far working edge, facing the screen and remaining clear of the laptop silhouette. A floor-mounted frosted-glass architectural partition fills the far-left background. A dusty blue matte-painted wall fills the broad upper-center and upper-right background. A slim brushed-metal architectural wall sconce is mounted high on the right side of that wall. Soft daylight enters from the left, with generous neutral fill and a faint neutral sconce glow. TRANSLATION-ONLY PRODUCT PLACEMENT; RECOMPOSED SUPPORT
